name: Milan Baskota
text: Smart Institute gave me the hands-on skills I needed. The Tally course was practical and the teachers were very helpful. I got a job within a month of completing the course!

name: Abishek Dangal
text: The Graphic Design course was excellent. I learned everything from the basics to advanced design tools. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to build a creative career.

name: Nischal Bhurtel
text: The Digital Marketing course was eye-opening. I now manage social media campaigns professionally. The trainers at Smart Institute are truly passionate about teaching.
